subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vulnerable
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **Susceptible**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Vulnerable" **means being open to physical or emotional harm or attacks. (असुरक्षित)

 
 
• **Example:** The small island is vulnerable to tropical storms.
